en.hubeali: Ahmad Bin Muhammad, from Ali Bin Al Hassan, from Ahmad in Sabeeh, from Anbasa Al Aabid who said,

‘The Prophet<sup>saww</sup> passed away upon Fasting Shaban and Ramazaan, and three days during every month – the first Thursday, and the middle Wednesday, and the last Thursday; and Abu Ja’far<sup>asws</sup> and Abu Abdullah<sup>asws</sup>, both were Fasting that’.
en.sarwar: 7. Ahmad ibn Muhammad has narrated from Ali ibn al-Hassan from Ahmad ibn Sabih from ‘Anbasah al-‘Abid in a Mawquf manner who has said the following:

“He (the Imam) ‘Alayhi al-Salam, has said, ‘The Messenger of Allah left this world practicing the fast of month of al-Sha‘ban and three days of every month, the first Thursday, the middle Wednesday and the last Thursday of the month. Abu Ja‘far, and abu ‘Abd Allah, ‘Alayhim al-Salam, would also do so.
